## Findings
- claim-1: The supplied JSON outputs are complete parseable objects, but task-35 omits explicit zero-pair lists; its counts and nonzero lists must be combined with the stipulated \(3^3\) box-pair domains to reconstruct those sets. [artifact 5f7eb5aa0d59e08aab90d3c02cf841a27757c565b9767b52f18b45541dd78853]
- claim-2: Under the finite box-basis hypothesis with \(J\)-columns \((22,221,32,222,321,33,322,331,332,333)\), both records give \(18\) nonzero Pieri products, \(36\) nonzero LR products, Pieri rank \(7\), LR rank \(7\), and Smith nonzero invariants \((1,1,1,1,1,1,1)\). [artifact 5f7eb5aa0d59e08aab90d3c02cf841a27757c565b9767b52f18b45541dd78853]
- claim-3: The F1 complement \((221,222,321,322,331,332,333)\) has a unimodular Pieri minor \(+1\), using rows \((22;h_1),(32;h_1),(221;h_1),(33;h_1),(222;h_1),(331;h_1),(332;h_1)\). All \(36\) listed nonzero LR rows have integral coordinates in this selected Pieri lattice. [artifact 5f7eb5aa0d59e08aab90d3c02cf841a27757c565b9767b52f18b45541dd78853]
- claim-4: The independently enumerated record uses reversed column order \((333,332,331,33,322,321,32,222,221,22)\), with fresh order digest `4fab47d24e13fd7e9209cb247b40d10c0e296ac9d6bde5c48b5d023aa1f22bf4`, Pieri digest `62ee90803236708aad718c4d530d770b0e48fa2c70c2aa34524210645e3d3cce`, and LR digest `3744a3be7e086134ce38f189b2954a7d439e79998a97142c69dc83cdc0559191`. [artifact 5f7eb5aa0d59e08aab90d3c02cf841a27757c565b9767b52f18b45541dd78853]
- claim-5: A semantic canonical digest agreeing across both schemas has not been supplied; the reported canonical JSON digests `671c93b02e33395aac1079af0392fdb879b2ea8f3be0411778b98a6f1b8bd571` and `789ba50b8895f6282f6791f9ef0e9cbf4723c5767fe010a5a31c533d65478355` are schema-dependent and unequal. [artifact 5598eb67bce9f870e45c19b0fe74a6a60bbd0eb4a519c4db1d78d916099e44f4]
## Strategy
No computation was executed: the two specified files and a sandbox action were not supplied in this interface. A strict cross-certificate validation therefore remains unperformed.

## Gaps
- Complete JSON parsing, duplicate-key rejection, and truncation checks are unverified.
- No canonical comparison, semantic digest recomputation, rank/minor certificates, or integral-containment checks were executed.
- F2 and full-LR unimodular certificates remain missing.
- The conclusion remains only an unsupported finite-box claim, conditional on the stated basis and presentation hypotheses.

## Next
Run the stipulated strict validator on both files; emit one schema-independent canonical serialization and matching SHA-256 digest; then provide indexed \(7\times7\) unimodular minors and checked integral reductions for Pieri/LR and both F1/F2 complements before critic and skeptic review.
